description: Western astrology synastry (relationship compatibility): compare two birth charts with cross-aspects, house overlays both ways and composite midpoints. Two natal charts compared: every cross-aspect with orbs, where each person's planets fall in the other's houses, harmonious/challenging counts, and composite (midpoint) positions and angles. Deterministic (JPL DE440, no LLM); every result carries meta.result_sha256. Price $0.12 per call via REST POST https://astro-agent.dev/v1/western/synastry (x402 or MPP); your first 3 calls are free here.

options.description: Optional calculation settings; every default is the common Western convention.

aspects.description: 'all' or a list from ['conjunction', 'opposition', 'trine', 'square', 'sextile', 'quincunx', 'semisextile', 'semisquare', 'sesquiquadrate', 'quintile', 'biquintile']. Default: the 5 majors.

house_system.description: House system for cusps and planet houses, e.g. 'placidus' (default) or 'whole_sign'.

luminary_orb_bonus.description: Extra orb in degrees for aspects involving the Sun or the Moon. Example: 2.

points.description: 'all' or a list from ['sun', 'moon', 'mercury', 'venus', 'mars', 'jupiter', 'saturn', 'uranus', 'neptune', 'pluto', 'mean_node', 'true_node', 'mean_lilith']. Default: 10 planets + true node + mean Lilith.

ambiguous_time.description: Which occurrence to use when a local time happens twice (DST fall-back).

datetime.description: Local birth date-time, ISO 8601: '1990-05-15T14:30' (local clock time at the place) or with an explicit offset '1990-05-15T14:30:00+02:00'. Alternative: 'date' + 'time'.

time.description: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, 24 h. Omit if unknown (computed at 12:00 with a TIME_UNKNOWN warning).

time_basis.description: What the given clock time is: civil wall-clock (default), UTC, Local Mean Time, or true (apparent) solar time.

timezone.description: IANA zone, e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata'. Optional: resolved from the coordinates, with the historical offset (DST, Local Mean Time) of that date.

name: synastry

endpoint.description: The REST route that computed it, e.g. 'western/natal'.

deterministic.description: Always true: same input, same result.

llm_used.description: Always false: no language model is involved.

payment.description: How this call was paid: protocol ('free' or 'none'), price and the free calls remaining.

reproducibility.description: How to reproduce and check this result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical 'result'; check it with verify_result_hash.

aspect_counts.description: Number of harmonious, challenging and conjunction cross-aspects.

composite_midpoints.description: Composite chart by midpoints: points, angles and the method used.

cross_aspects.description: Aspects between a point of person A and a point of person B, with orb and exactness.

house_overlays.description: Which house of the other chart each person's points fall in.

person_a.description: First person's chart: subject, points and angles.

person_b.description: Second person's chart: subject, points and angles.

settings.description: Settings applied: zodiac, house system and the aspect set with its orbs.

warnings.description: Notes on the input or the calculation (for example an assumed noon for an unknown birth time). Present only when there is something to say.
